en.html:
By the time Konatsu finally asked me that, the night was late and it was time for bed.

Since then, not a word between us. Walked home, parted from Tadayasu, arrived, ate, bathed. All that time, the only people we spoke to were Uncle and Auntie.

Neither of us was exactly bursting with life. They noticed, but not enough to question us closely. Fortunately. No unnecessary worries for either side.

Come home with injuries from a beating, and it would have been different.

Thinking of that, I was a little worried about Tadayasu.

小夏がようやくおれにそう聞いてきたのは、既に夜
も更けて就寝の頃。

　あれから何も言葉を交わさずおれたちは家路を辿り、
忠保と別れ、家について食事をして風呂にも入った。
　その間、口を利いたのはおじさんおばさんとだけだ。

　おれも小夏も元気溌剌とはいかなかったから二人に
は不審がられたものの、問い詰められるほどのことは
なく、互いに余計な心労を背負わずに済んだのは幸い
だった。

　殴られて怪我でもしていたら話はまた変わっていた
だろうが。
　そう考えると、忠保のことは少し心配だった。

en.html:
It rankled. Even for one day, I had trusted a man like that.

My fault. I had trusted him on my own, expected things on my own. I thought so.

Thinking so did not remove the anger. But it did turn me forward. Forget that man. Forget, start again, trust only ourselves and our friends like before.

Fine.

From the beginning, what else had there been?

But no need to do the same thing again.
